input.body:
Dear Riverside Works,

Re: Blocked toilet, Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ3 2ZZ (ref R/PM002-1). Tenant: Noah Turner.

Our records show a visit was arranged after 10:30 following your call on 8 August to remove the toilet and clear the blockage at the pan connector, but we have not yet received an outcome.

Please could you let us know whether the visit took place and what was found. If the blockage was cleared, please send completion photos and your invoice. If further work is needed (e.g. removal/replacement of the pan), please send a quote with photos and the estimated completion time, and do not proceed with that additional work until we confirm the landlord's approval. If the visit did not go ahead, please tell us why and when you can attend.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team, Northbridge Lettings

Ticket 6 has events extending to 19 Aug, which is future relative to ticket 9's reference point of 11 Aug, so I shouldn't draw on that later information. I can still note that ticket 6 is a duplicate record of the same job as 014, but I need to limit myself to only the events that fall within the known timeframe.

For ticket 9, I'll focus on acting rather than escalating heavily: chase the contractor for the visit outcome given the ambiguity around the 8 Aug call, place a short hold (one day since the toilet is blocked and somewhat urgent), and flag the duplicate ticket issue at low priority so ops can merge rather than risk double-messaging the contractor or tenant.
